_architecture_note: Module 13 denies the `exec` tool, so the agent cannot run the Python scripts itself. Instead, SYSTEM cron runs them and writes to deals/_inbox/; the agent reads those files via the filesystem MCP. This keeps deterministic extraction outside the model AND keeps shell access away from the agent. Both properties matter.
_system_crontab: # Add to the operator user's crontab (crontab -e), NOT to OpenClaw:

jobs.prompt: Run deal-desk-brief. Read today's sweep from deals/_inbox/ and send me the briefing. If the sweep file is missing or reports source errors, lead with that.
Run closing-watch. Alert only on exceptions.
Run closing-watch. Alert only on exceptions.
